title: Derivative coefficient energy and influence
statement: Let $F$ be a real coefficient family on subsets of $[n]$, and let $i\in[n]$. The sum, over all $S\subseteq[n]$, of the squares of the coefficients formed from the Fourier coefficients of the Boolean-cube derivative of $F$ equals the influence of coordinate $i$ for the Boolean-cube function obtained by evaluating $F$ in the Walsh basis.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on subsets of $[n]$
